lineage: MAC > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung  SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool v1.01) > .flac encoding

ai_review.summary: Energetic show praised by fans, but the recording suffers from noticeable hiss and a muffled Dolby effect.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave about the performance, calling it a stellar show, while also commending the effort put into tapping the concert. However, the audio transfer is described as hazy, with a layer of hiss and an odd Dolby‑style coloration that separates the listener from the music. The result is a solid musical experience hampered by moderate recording imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments about the show boost the rating, but two reviewers note audible hiss and tonal issues that lower the overall score; with only two reviews confidence is moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss throughout the set creates a foggy window effect; possible Dolby processing at the venue makes the mix sound slightly muffled after transfer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on song order or pacing, but overall enthusiasm suggests a well‑received performance.
